capabilities: Browse a catalog of Obsidian game plugins
Keep a player profile with friends, achievements, badges and leaderboards
Sync finished runs from opt-in game plugins via the SDK
Convert avatars, icons and badges to small WebP images
extras: Catalog browsing works signed out; everything else needs an account. Data goes only to the official ObsiGama server; an Online/sync off switch stops all network requests. Games are manually reviewed before listing; Safari/iOS cannot encode WebP avatars yet.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in game hub, so players cannot track runs, achievements, friends or leaderboards across separate game plugins.

relations.evidence: no Supabase keys, tokens or other secrets in the plugin
Ready integration code + manifests for the two existing games (Mini Old Games, HELLVAULT)

requires.name: a game plugin with the Connect to ObsiGama toggle

summary: Online game hub for Obsidian: account, profile, game catalog, library, friends, achievements, badges and leaderboards, syncing runs from opt-in game plugins.
